# Security policy (budget-focused fork)

This repository is an unofficial fork of [Securo](https://github.com/securo-finance/securo).

## Where to report

- **A vulnerability in the fork's own code** (the files listed in [`CLAUDE.md`](../CLAUDE.md):
  the annual budget plan, CDI yield, recurring links, month outlook, sidebar groups, fork rule
  actions, `scripts/fork/`, `.github/workflows/fork-privacy.yml`): open a private report with
  **Security → Report a vulnerability** on this repository. Please don't open a public issue.
- **A vulnerability in Securo itself** (anything that also exists upstream): report it to the
  upstream project as its [security policy](../SECURITY.md) describes, not here.

Not sure which one it is? Report it here privately; it will be forwarded upstream if it belongs there.

## Supported versions

Only the latest `v<upstream version>-plan.<N>` release and `main` receive fixes.
